basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old freelance writer from Toronto, Canada, with a penchant for 80s and 90s TV shows and classic gaming. I spend my evenings revisiting old sitcoms and arguing about their cultural impact online. During the daytime, I write lifestyle articles and occasionally dabble in photography, primarily with medium format cameras. I’m in a long-term relationship and my partner often joins me in my retro TV marathons. My typical online hours are late evenings to early mornings, where I dive into discussions about nostalgia or personal finance. I have a soft spot for humor and can’t resist a good pun.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in English Literature and have been writing professionally for over a decade. My interest in personal finance and investment led me to self-educate in financial planning through online courses and community forums. I have a vast knowledge of 80s and 90s pop culture, stemming from a childhood spent in front of the TV and a drive to explore the cultural context of that era.
